scientific_integrity: The prior full-set formula and finite-dimensional numerical-range dualities are explicitly attributed; numerical tests are corroborative and not substitutes for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact essential range is taken from Muller--Tomilov Theorem 4.5; only the symmetric Toeplitz family is treated. The sharp Hausdorff order does not determine its global leading coefficient. Equivalence in unindexed literature cannot be ruled out; no independent audit.
title: Pointed tangent bodies and sharp normal cones for non-Hilbert Toeplitz numerical ranges
